body: I felt my curiosity growing as I stepped closer, noticing small patches of fur underfoot that didn't belong in the quiet compound. The rustling of leaves nearby suggested someone was moving about unseen. My pulse quickened, and I knew there was something deeply fascinating about these stray animals who wandered free.
